title: Security and privacy
description: "What protects the page, what leaves your browser and to whom, and what Hashi keeps: only your own swaps, in your own browser."
icon: Lock
---

## Headers

| Header | Value |
|---|---|
| Content-Security-Policy | `default-src 'self'`; scripts from Hashi itself plus inline scripts (`'unsafe-inline'`, needed by Next.js's bootstrap) and WebAssembly for the Bitcoin Cash library; images from any https origin; connections to any https or wss origin (the providers are called directly); frames only for WalletConnect's verify page; `frame-ancestors 'none'`, `object-src 'none'` |
| X-Frame-Options | `DENY` |
| X-Content-Type-Options | `nosniff` |
| Referrer-Policy | `strict-origin-when-cross-origin` |

## What leaves your browser

| To | What |
|---|---|
| NEAR Intents | tokens, amount, slippage, deadline; your addresses once wallets are connected (placeholder addresses before); your deposit transaction |
| THORChain | tokens, amount, slippage, your destination once connected; your deposit transaction |
| Cauldron Router | the trade, and for a build your own coins and addresses |
| Electrum servers | your wallet's addresses, and the transactions you sign |
| WizardConnect relays | the connection and sign requests between Hashi and your wallet |
| Reown | wallet sessions; Solana balance reads |
| Chain RPCs (AppKit's default transports) | your EVM address, for balances on 7 chains every 30 s; gas prices |
| Hashi's relayer | a gasless USDC authorisation, only when you use it |
| Hashi's server | a swap contract's public terms (never the swap's key), when a swap into PUSD or MUSD starts |

AppKit's analytics are off. The landing page asks the providers from the server with placeholder addresses: no visitor data.

## What Hashi keeps

| Where | What |
|---|---|
| your browser's IndexedDB | your swaps (`hashi-swap:…`), with their addresses, the bridge's signed quote and, for a swap into PUSD or MUSD, its contract's terms and the swap's own key (it can only pay you) |
| your browser's localStorage | your slippage, your theme, the WizardConnect session, and Reown AppKit's and wagmi's own connection keys |
| the server | rate-limit counters, in memory; and each swap contract's public terms (your Bitcoin Cash address, the token, the floor, the refund time, the swap key's public half), so its keeper can send unfinished BCH back to you |

No accounts, no database, no analytics of Hashi's own.
